title: Audrey Tsung
text:
Hi, my name is Audrey and I am from Vancouver, BC. I completed a BSc in Computer Science with a minor in Data Science at UBC, where I developed a strong interes AI/ML systems evaluation and large-scale data workflows. This interest ultimately led me to pursue the Master of Data Science program. This website documents my experiences, learning journey, and personal growth throughout the MDS program.
This is a Quarto website.
To learn more about Quarto websites visit https://quarto.org/docs/websites.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
My first couple weeks of MDS have been a bit surreal. Coming back to UBC Campus after my undergraduate degree here is a big blessing, there are so many familar and unfamiliar things that I wish to explore.
Classes have been busy and hectic but that is something that is to be expected for an accelerated program.
